posts.title: The arrival, in three taps
posts.caption:
Bags down. Phone out. The Wi-Fi answer is right there.

DigiStayBook brings your welcome, house guidance and guest memories together behind one QR code. Guests open it in their phone's browser—no app download and no guest account.

This walkthrough uses our made-up demo property. We're getting ready for launch, and we'd love to know: what should a guest find first when they arrive at your place?

Follow Digi Staybook for the next look inside.

#DigiStayBook #HolidayRental #HostTips

posts.title: The five lines worth writing first
posts.caption:
Starting a house guide? Start with the answers guests need before they start exploring.

Where to park. How to connect. How to get comfortable. What goes in which bin. What to do at checkout.

Keep each answer short, specific to your place and easy to find. Your welcome can still sound like you.

DigiStayBook puts house guidance alongside your welcome and guest memories. Screens here are from our made-up demo cottage.

Save this list for your next guide update, and follow our prelaunch progress.

#DigiStayBook #HolidayLet #HostingTips
posts.story: Share slide 1, then ask: Which of these is missing from your guide?
posts.visual: Five 1080×1350 slides. Lead with a text checklist; use a real demo screen only on the final slide. Do not show actual door codes or network credentials.
frames: Start with the first five answers
Parking + Wi-Fi: say exactly where and how
Heating + bins: the details that differ at your property
Checkout: a clear time and a short list
One place to find them. Demo shown. Follow Digi Staybook.
posts.alt: A five-slide house-guide checklist covering parking, Wi-Fi, heating, bins and checkout.

Try three things: a friendly hello, one thing that makes your property special, and where to find the practical answers.

DigiStayBook gives your arrival note a place at the top of the guest wall, with house guidance nearby. The example shown is from our made-up demo property.

What is the first sentence in your current welcome? We'd love to hear how you greet your guests.

DigiStayBook is being built to make that information easy to find after a scan. No app and no account for guests.

posts.title: Make a recommendation useful
posts.caption:
A local recommendation is more helpful when guests know why you picked it.

Instead of only naming a place, add what you like about it, who it might suit, and one practical detail you've checked.

For example: a good walk for a quiet morning, with a note about the route. Keep opening hours and access details up to date rather than treating your guide as finished forever.

DigiStayBook's demo shows how a local note can sit in the welcome. Sample property shown.

Save this for your next guide refresh.

#DigiStayBook #LocalKnowledge #HostTips

Add who it suits + a practical detail you've checked
Keep it current. Sample demo shown. Follow Digi Staybook.

posts.title: A guide for the guest who skims
posts.caption:
Some guests will read every word. Others will go straight to the answer they need.

Short labels help: Wi-Fi. Parking. Heating. Checkout. Put the detail underneath, in plain language.

That's the approach behind the house-guidance buttons in DigiStayBook. The screen is from our made-up demo cottage.

Which label would your property need that isn't on that list?

posts.caption:
A welcome for people staying with you is different from a wall you share publicly.

DigiStayBook has an in-stay guest wall with your house guidance, and a separate public wall for sharing guest memories. You can switch off the public wall.

The screenshots in this series are from a made-up demo property. Never put private access codes in a public marketing image.

Hosts: which parts of a welcome would you keep just for guests during their stay?

posts.title: A guest memory is not a booking review
posts.caption:
The note in a guestbook has a different job from a review on a booking platform.

DigiStayBook is a place for your house guidance and the memories guests choose to leave. It doesn't submit reviews to booking sites or promise better ratings.

The wall pictured is our made-up demo property, with sample content.

posts.title: Your wall, your approval choice
posts.caption:
Want to check new memories before they appear?

DigiStayBook includes an approval setting for new memories. Guest submissions also go through automated safety checks, and hosts can hide or remove memories from the wall.

Safety checks are part of the process, not a guarantee that every issue will be caught. Restricted safety cases have a separate review route.

This is a product preview using a made-up demo property. What would you want explained about host approval?

posts.title: A better welcome, one scan away

A little more welcome. A little less hunting for the right answer. A place for the memories guests leave.

That's what we're building with DigiStayBook: one QR display opening your welcome, house guidance, local favourites and a guest memory wall in the phone's browser.
